purpose: Business promotion inspiration, not real listings

categories.title: Cleaning
categories.intro: Give new customers a clear first step into your cleaning service. A focused package can introduce your business while keeping the work, property size and service area manageable.

ideas.title: First-home-clean package
ideas.description: Introduce your business with a defined clean for new customers.
ideas.scopeNote: Specify hours, rooms, tasks, supplies and any property-size limit.

ideas.title: Midweek oven clean
ideas.description: Promote oven cleaning on selected quieter weekdays.
ideas.scopeNote: State oven type, size and whether racks or additional appliances are included.

ideas.title: Carpet + upholstery bundle
ideas.description: Combine selected carpet areas with a sofa or chair clean.
ideas.scopeNote: Define room sizes, seat count, fabric exclusions and extra stain-treatment charges.

ideas.title: End-of-tenancy clean
ideas.description: Offer a clear cleaning package for people moving out.
ideas.scopeNote: Define property size and inclusions; do not guarantee a bond refund.

categories.title: Garden & Outdoors
categories.intro: Help local homeowners get on top of their outdoor jobs. Promote a well-defined service in suburbs you already cover, with enough detail to manage travel time, access and workload.

ideas.title: Lawn mow + edges
ideas.description: Bundle mowing and edge trimming for a tidy finish.
ideas.scopeNote: Set a lawn-area limit and explain slope, access and overgrown-lawn conditions.

ideas.title: Seasonal garden tidy
ideas.description: Offer a fixed block of time for selected garden tasks.
ideas.scopeNote: List included tasks, labour hours and whether green-waste removal is included.

ideas.title: Hedge-trimming package
ideas.description: Promote trimming for suitable hedges in your service area.
ideas.scopeNote: Specify length, height, access and waste disposal; quote larger work separately.

ideas.title: Driveway water blasting
ideas.description: Promote cleaning for eligible driveways or paved areas.
ideas.scopeNote: Specify surface type and area; assess suitability and explain water/access requirements.

categories.title: Home Maintenance
categories.intro: Show local homeowners which jobs your business can help with. Specific, manageable packages make it easier to understand the work and request the right service.

ideas.title: Single-storey gutter clean
ideas.description: Promote a gutter clean for eligible homes.
ideas.scopeNote: Define gutter length, safe-access requirements, downpipe scope and disposal.

ideas.title: Window-cleaning package
ideas.description: Bundle selected inside or outside windows.
ideas.scopeNote: State pane count, storeys, access and whether tracks or screens are included.

ideas.title: Small handyman job bundle
ideas.description: Offer a time allowance for a defined list of small tasks.
ideas.scopeNote: Specify eligible work, labour, materials and exclusions; preserve applicable trade requirements.

ideas.title: Seasonal home check
ideas.description: Offer a visual check with a written list of maintenance observations.
ideas.scopeNote: Describe its scope accurately; do not call it a certified inspection unless that is the actual qualified service.

categories.title: Car Wash & Detailing
categories.intro: Turn spare wash-bay or mobile-detailing capacity into a reason to try your business. Make each package easy to compare by clearly describing the finish and vehicle coverage.

ideas.title: Midweek full valet
ideas.description: Promote an interior and exterior package on selected weekdays.
ideas.scopeNote: List every included task, vehicle sizes, booking rules and extra-soiling charges.

ideas.title: Interior deep clean
ideas.description: Offer a focused clean for seats, carpets and interior surfaces.
ideas.scopeNote: Specify the methods and inclusions; explain pet-hair, stain and odour exclusions.

ideas.title: Wash + wax package
ideas.description: Combine an exterior wash with a defined protective finish.
ideas.scopeNote: Name what is applied and the coverage; avoid unsupported durability claims.

ideas.title: Two-car household offer
ideas.description: Bundle eligible vehicles at one location or booking.
ideas.scopeNote: Define vehicle eligibility, location, access and how the package price is calculated.

categories.title: Servicing & Repairs
categories.intro: Give drivers a clear reason to discover your workshop. Promote services you can price and deliver consistently, with vehicle eligibility and possible extra work explained upfront.

ideas.title: Oil + filter package
ideas.description: Promote an oil and filter change for selected vehicles.
ideas.scopeNote: Specify eligible vehicles, oil specification and quantity, filter, labour and extra charges.

ideas.title: Off-peak service booking
ideas.description: Offer selected service packages during quieter workshop periods.
ideas.scopeNote: Name the service scope and available days; do not imply live availability without integration.

ideas.title: Battery check package
ideas.description: Introduce a battery testing service with clearly listed checks.
ideas.scopeNote: State what the test covers and whether replacement parts or fitting cost extra.

ideas.title: Diagnostic assessment
ideas.description: Offer a defined initial diagnostic assessment.
ideas.scopeNote: Set the time allowance and report scope; assessment does not guarantee a diagnosis or repair.

categories.title: Tyres & Wheels
categories.intro: Introduce drivers to your tyre and wheel services with a specific, easy-to-understand offer. Clear vehicle and equipment requirements help customers choose an appropriate booking.

ideas.title: Wheel alignment
ideas.description: Promote an alignment for eligible vehicles.
ideas.scopeNote: State two-wheel or four-wheel scope and any adjustments, exclusions or extra work.

ideas.title: Rotation + balancing
ideas.description: Bundle tyre rotation with balancing for eligible wheels.
ideas.scopeNote: Specify wheel count, sizes, compatibility and exclusions.

ideas.title: Selected tyre package
ideas.description: Create a package for named tyre sizes or ranges.
ideas.scopeNote: Specify products, quantity, fitting, balancing, disposal, availability and total applicable charges.

ideas.title: Puncture assessment
ideas.description: Offer an assessment of a damaged tyre.
ideas.scopeNote: Repair is subject to suitability; show assessment and repair charges separately when applicable.
